title: Designing voice-first software for everyday commerce
description: How natural-language voice and document vision replace complex data-entry screens for fast-moving retail and wholesale merchants.
heroAlt: Sarkit voice-to-ledger workflow for everyday commerce.
html:
Traditional ERP software assumes every merchant has time to sit at a keyboard and type structured SKU rows. In fast-moving retail and wholesale markets, that assumption fails.

Voice and Vision as the Primary Interface

With Sarkit, merchants simply speak a transaction in their natural language or snap a photo of a supplier invoice. The platform extracts line items, matches products, and updates the ledger automatically.
